$comment: G1 through the side door. The six engine blocks plus `domain` are required and additional properties are closed, so a detector reading only `required` finds nothing wrong — and the contract still states a seventh engine block, `electronics`, as an optional property. Optional or not, it is a name the engine fixes about one subject, and a curriculum in another subject validates against a contract that has an electronics block in it. Only a fixed expectation over the full property set catches a seventh arriving. Must be refused as `unit-block-set-wrong`. Never an input to a run.
